ITEM 1 | Single piece of cooked meat or fish, roughly rectangular/wedge-shaped, about 5 cm long by 3 cm wide and 2 cm tall; one side has a dark brown, crisp, slightly charred skin with mottled texture, the cut face is light pinkish-tan and moist-looking with fine flaky grain; sits alone in the center-right of a large white square plate with no sauce or garnish visible | 60

ITEM 2 | Small smear of light orange-tan residue and a few tiny flecks at the left edge of the main piece, possibly juices or oil, thin and glossy, not a distinct portion | 3
